newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER SHOWCASE-DADS TIP SONS TO PLAY FOR FINALISTS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-DADS TIP SONS TO PLAY FOR FINALISTS.

text.p: Two British fathers have bet that their young sons will play for the Middlesbrough and Chelsea sides of the future.

Shaun Ward has placed a series of wagers that his three-year-old son Ashton will play for Boro in an F.A. Cup final, represent England in a World Cup final and become Middlesbrough manager by the age of 45.
Ward stands to win 33,500 pounds ($55,000) from his 10 pounds ($16) stake if his son succeeds on all three fronts.
Nick Beadle has bet one pound ($1.6) at 25,000-1 that his five-year-old son Tommy will play for Chelsea and England before the year 2014.
Middlesbrough face Chelsea in the F.A. Cup final at Wembley on Saturday.
